title: Guest Towel Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass | Matte White | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass | Countertop Vanity Hand Towel Holder Rack | Allied Brass
description:
Keep clean hand towels by the sink without wall mounting in Matte White, which brings clean, fresh simplicity that brightens spaces and creates a light, airy bathroom atmosphere. This Carolina Collection guest towel stand is a countertop towel stand (also called a towel holder or towel rack) designed for vanity-top use in the bathroom or bath.

Highlights:
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stable on counters: Heavy base helps prevent the towel stand from tipping during daily use
- Countertop protection: Felt pad on the bottom helps prevent scratching on bathroom surfaces
- Traditional coordination: Made to complement matching Carolina and other classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Solid brass build: Crafted from solid brass materials (brass construction)

Specs:
- Product type: Countertop/vanity-top guest towel stand (freestanding; not wall-mounted / not wall hanging)
- Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 x 14 x 5.5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 8 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs.
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
